strings.zh: 哈哈,今天的拍卖会{NEWLINE}真是大赚一笔啊。
strings.en: Ha ha! We made a killing at today’s{NEWLINE}auction.

strings.zh: 你是什么人？{NEWLINE}怎么进来的？！{CLEAR}赶紧给我出去！
strings.en: Who are you? How did you get in here?!{NEWLINE}Get out right now!

strings.zh: 有人拿了臭臭花到你这里来卖？
strings.en: Someone brought a Gloom to sell?
strings.notes: #2–#5: the player's choices (Gloom / buy / sell / leave). | menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'Did someone bring you a Gloom to sell?'; ext-review LD-002

strings.zh: 我是来买精灵的
strings.en: I’m here to buy Pokémon

strings.zh: 我手头有珍稀的精灵要卖
strings.en: I have rare Pokémon to sell

strings.zh: 对不起,打扰了
strings.en: Sorry to bother you

strings.zh: 我们这里是私人会所,{NEWLINE}没有邀请禁止入内。{CLEAR}赶紧给我滚！
strings.en: This is a private club. No entry without{NEWLINE}an invitation. Get lost!

strings.zh: 你在胡说什么？{NEWLINE}我们这里是高端的私人娱乐会所,{CLEAR}不是买卖精灵的市场！{SCROLL}我不知道你是怎么进来的,{NEWLINE}但是你现在马上给我滚！
strings.en: What are you talking about?{SCROLL}This is an exclusive private{NEWLINE}entertainment club, not a market for{CLEAR}buying and selling Pokémon!{SCROLL}I don’t know how you got in here, but{NEWLINE}get lost right now!

strings.zh: 你这个穷逼没听懂我的话吗？{NEWLINE}我让你滚出去啊。
strings.en: Are you deaf, you broke-ass loser? I{NEWLINE}said get the hell out!
strings.notes: zh 穷逼 kept at strength.

strings.zh: 就你带的这些精灵,{NEWLINE}多的就像路边的野狗,{CLEAR}哪个会买你的哦。{CLEAR}赶紧给我滚！
strings.en: The Pokémon you’ve got are as common{NEWLINE}as stray dogs by the roadside. Who’d{CLEAR}ever buy them? Get lost!

strings.zh: 我一眼就看出您身价不凡,{NEWLINE}绝对是那种社会精英人上人！{CLEAR}我跟您说您要是喜欢精灵,{CLEAR}来我们这里买准没错。{SCROLL}您喜欢什么样的精灵就跟我们说,{NEWLINE}我们会想办法给您弄来的。{CLEAR}今天的拍卖会上有个人{CLEAR}就买到了他预定的那种臭臭花。{CLEAR}没错,就跟莉佳馆主的那只一模一样,{CLEAR}能够分泌珍贵的香水原料哦！{SCROLL}整个关东,您只有在我们这里{NEWLINE}才能买到这么稀有的精灵。
strings.en: I could tell at a glance that you’re{NEWLINE}someone special.{SCROLL}A true member of the elite!{SCROLL}Let me tell you, if you like Pokémon, you{NEWLINE}can’t go wrong buying from us.{SCROLL}Tell us what kind of Pokémon you want,{NEWLINE}and we’ll find a way to get it for you.{SCROLL}At today’s auction, one man got exactly{NEWLINE}the Gloom he’d ordered. That’s right,{CLEAR}just like Gym Leader Erika’s! It gives{CLEAR}off a precious perfume ingredient!{SCROLL}In all of Kanto, only here can you buy{NEWLINE}such rare Pokémon.

strings.zh: 哇,原来您带着{NEWLINE}这么珍稀的精灵啊。{CLEAR}那肯定能卖个好价钱。{SCROLL}我跟您说,就今天有个人{NEWLINE}拿了一只非常特殊的臭臭花来,{CLEAR}没错,就跟莉佳馆主的那只一模一样,{CLEAR}能够分泌珍贵的香水原料哦！{CLEAR}这只臭臭花卖了一个非常高的价钱。{SCROLL}整个关东,您只有在我们这里{NEWLINE}才能找到出这么多钱的买主！
strings.en: Wow, so you’ve brought such rare{NEWLINE}Pokémon!{SCROLL}They’ll fetch a good price for sure.{SCROLL}Let me tell you, just today someone{NEWLINE}brought in a very special Gloom. That’s{CLEAR}right, just like Gym Leader Erika’s! It{CLEAR}gives off a precious perfume ingredient!{SCROLL}That Gloom sold for a very high price.{SCROLL}In all of Kanto, only here will you find{NEWLINE}buyers willing to pay that much!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你提到有人买了臭臭花？{NEWLINE}是谁买的？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You said someone bought a{NEWLINE}Gloom? Who bought it?

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,那可是在地下交易界{NEWLINE}赫赫有名的「收藏家」。{CLEAR}他每次来我们这里,{CLEAR}都可以买到超级珍稀的精灵哦！
strings.en: Heh heh. That’d be the Collector,{NEWLINE}famous in the underground trade.{SCROLL}Every time he comes here, he gets{NEWLINE}super-rare Pokémon!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,那可是在地下交易界{NEWLINE}赫赫有名的「收藏家」。{CLEAR}他每次买珍稀精灵可都是一掷千金！{CLEAR}你的精灵要卖给他的话,{CLEAR}一定也能卖个好价钱的。
strings.en: Heh heh. That’d be the Collector,{NEWLINE}famous in the underground trade. He{CLEAR}spends a fortune every time he buys{CLEAR}rare Pokémon!{SCROLL}If you sell your Pokémon to him, you’ll{NEWLINE}get a good price for sure.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『「收藏家」？{NEWLINE}他是谁？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The Collector? Who’s that?

strings.zh: 你是来买精灵的{NEWLINE}还是来查户口的？{CLEAR}不买就给我滚！
strings.en: Are you here to buy Pokémon or to{NEWLINE}interrogate me? If you’re not buying,{CLEAR}get lost!

strings.zh: 你是来做生意的{NEWLINE}还是来查户口的？{CLEAR}不卖精灵就给我滚！
strings.en: Are you here to do business or to{NEWLINE}interrogate me? If you’re not selling{CLEAR}Pokémon, get lost!

strings.zh: 主人您好,欢迎您的光临。
strings.en: Welcome, sir. Thank you for coming.

strings.zh: 老板您好,欢迎您的光临。
strings.en: Welcome, boss. Thank you for coming.

strings.zh: 你谁啊？看什么看？我认识你吗？
strings.en: Who are you? What are you looking at?{NEWLINE}Do I know you?

strings.zh: 我带了一只素利拍来,{NEWLINE}专为那些睡眠不好的人治疗失眠。{CLEAR}你可以找它试一试。
strings.en: I brought a Hypno to help people who{NEWLINE}can’t sleep well get over their{CLEAR}insomnia. You can give it a try.

strings.zh: 这里原来是个非法的会所,{NEWLINE}现在被改成市民休闲中心了。
strings.en: This used to be an illegal club. Now it’s{NEWLINE}been turned into a leisure center for{CLEAR}the citizens.

strings.zh: 你好啊,{NEWLINE}你也是来这里放空自己的吗？
strings.en: Hello. Did you come here to clear your{NEWLINE}head too?

strings.zh: 在繁华喧闹的彩虹市中{NEWLINE}有这么一个幽静的地方很不错呢。
strings.en: It’s nice to have a peaceful spot like{NEWLINE}this in bustling Celadon City.

strings.zh: 休闲中心的书还挺全的,{NEWLINE}连最新一期的口袋迷杂志都有。
strings.en: The leisure center has a good selection{NEWLINE}of books. They even have the latest{CLEAR}issue of the Pokémon fan magazine.
strings.notes: zh 口袋迷杂志; 口袋迷 is Game Freak elsewhere, but here reads as a fan magazine.

strings.zh: 素利拍『Hyp——no！
strings.en: Hypno: Hyp-no!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,在这里可以打游戏！
strings.en: Heh heh, you can play games here!

strings.zh: 要让素利拍帮你催眠休息一下吗？
strings.en: Would you like Hypno to help you get{NEWLINE}some rest?

strings.zh: 睡起来之后精神好多了。
strings.en: I feel so much more refreshed after{NEWLINE}that nap.

strings.zh: 真是多亏你介绍我来这里,{NEWLINE}我现在的失眠症状好多了。{CLEAR}原来买的保健品再也用不到了,{CLEAR}送给你吧。
strings.en: Thanks to you telling me about this{NEWLINE}place, my insomnia is much better now.{SCROLL}I won’t need the health supplements I{NEWLINE}bought anymore. You can have them.

strings.zh: 自从知道了这里,{NEWLINE}再也不怕失眠了。
strings.en: Now that I know about this place, I’m{NEWLINE}not afraid of insomnia anymore.
